get_inside.text: Ancient Cavern
The entrance to Kuradal's Dungeon is a cave near Kuradal in the Ancient Cavern. She is located in the back of the dungeon, on the opposite side of the whirlpool entrance, and up the stairs.
There are four ways to get to the entrance:
Using a ferocious ring to teleport to Kuradal.
Using a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Kuradal.

Entering the Ancient Cavern via the lake above Baxtorian Falls, at the head of the River Dougne. To enter the cavern, players must jump off the dock on the north side of the lake into the whirlpool (followers such as pets or familiars cannot be out at this time). To be able to enter this way, players must have completed Barbarian Training up to the pyre ships part of barbarian Firemaking. One fast way to get to the dock is to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace or Barbarian Teleport (Lunar spellbook).

Use Fairy ring code BJQ to teleport to the Ancient Cavern. Partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings, and the ring in the cavern must first be repaired before it can be used. This is done by using 5 bittercap mushrooms and a spade on the inner ring.
Kuradal's Dungeon (Ancient Cavern)

place.title: Kuradal's Dungeon
place.summary: Once in the dungeon, players can only attack the Slayer monster they were assigned, and only while the task has not been completed. All monsters in the dungeon except dark beasts, greater demons, hellhounds, and gargoyles are non-aggressive. The aggressive monsters can attack players, but players cannot retaliate unless the monster is part of the assignment. The ferocious ring can be obtained as a drop from these monsters, which has multiple passive effects when equipped while inside the dungeon.

get_inside.text: Wilderness
The quest version of the ruins in Spirit Realm, Summer's farm, should be accessed from the Spirit of Summer quest start point, just northeast of Varrock.
Games necklace teleport to the Corporeal Beast. Exit the cave and run south. (Requires completion of Summer's End)
Wilderness Crater lodestone teleport, then run north-east to the ruins.
Take a canoe into the Wilderness. Run southeast to the ruins.
Carrallangar Teleport to Graveyard of Shadows, exit east or west, then run north.
The ancient obelisk along with the obelisk shard and portable obelisk, exit east or west, then run north.

The Ruins are in close proximity to the Corporeal Beast's lair, which makes reaching it fairly simple. By using a Games necklace to teleport to it, then walking to the Ruins, it is possible to reach the area very quickly.

Not far to the south, below the Graveyard of Shadows, is a Wilderness obelisk, which allows players to travel to other obelisks found at different locations within the Wilderness. Before completing the hard Wilderness achievements this method of travel is unreliable because players are unable to choose their destination, but afterwards players can right-click the obelisk and choose which one they would like to teleport to. The Graveyard of Shadows obelisk is in Level 18 Wilderness.
Alternatively, players may reach the Ruins by running north from Varrock or north-east from Edgeville.
Abandoned Farm (level 28 Wilderness)

place.title: Ruins (east)
place.summary: In the Spirit of Summer and Summer's End quests, players learn about the Bonde family who built the farm and about the Bonde Farm massacre in which they were killed. The fabric of reality surrounding the farm is naturally weak, and has been further weakened by the Spirit Beast, an entity from a parallel dimension. This has made the farm something of a spacial anomaly, causing constant physical and spiritual overlaps between The Void, the Spirit Realm, and the world of Gielinor itself.

Mort Myre Swamp, once a forest known as Humblethorn, is a swampland in western Morytania. It is a place plagued by Ghasts. Therefore, not even a full inventory of food will keep players safe here, because ghasts will decompose any kind of food. ml.name: Uzer

get_inside.text: Kharidian Desert
Entrance to the underground remains of Uzer
pic: Entrance to the underground remains of Uzer

get_inside.text: Walk east of the Dominion Tower
Walk east of Shantay Pass
Uzer can be reached easily after Eagles' Peak is completed by flying a Desert eagle in the Eagle transport system.
Ali Morrisane's magic carpet will only be available after The Golem quest.
Fairy ring - DLQ, then walk north-east
Traveller's necklace to south of the Desert Eagle's Eyrie and then walk south-east
Desert amulet 4 to teleport directly there.
Ruins

The ruins of various buildings and large kilns are in the vicinity of the temple (the large kilns were used to manufacture golems). Several buildings contain crates. Many are extremely small. The city itself does not seem to have been extremely large–perhaps the size of Lumbridge or Draynor, though it may be that Uzer was once much larger but very little remains to be seen . The ruins and the golem are all that remain above the desert sands. Talking to the latter is the way to start The Golem quest. Though there are a number of golem parts strewn around the area, there are no human remains with the exception of ghosts in the temple basement. Very prominent in the area is a large, ornate building that forms the upper part of the temple complex. It is inscribed with the symbols of many gods and has stairs in the centre leading down to the temple basement.
Temple basement

Underneath the city lies the temple basement. To the north-east of the entrance black mushrooms spawn, while in the north-west, one can find a strange implement. Statues of craftsmen adorn the halls while golem pieces litter the ground. A few ghosts lurk in the hallways. At the far end lies a portal to Thammaron's realm. This basement, being underground, is safe from the desert heat effect.
Throne room

Thammaron's Throne Room is red and grey, while a causeway of horns breaking the ground leads to his throne. To the right of the entrance lies the remains of Thammaron. Members can use a chisel on the throne to receive two cut sapphires, two cut emeralds, and two cut rubies. This room is also a focal part of the Shadow of the Storm quest.
Uzer mine
The Uzer mine is found northwest of of the ruins, containing 3 necrite rocks. Between the mine and the ruins are also two acadia trees.
Uzer

place.title: Uzer
place.summary: When Zamorak returned from banishment and declared war upon the gods, the God Wars broke out and the Kharidian Desert became a site of many battles. Many other gods sent their armies towards the Kharidian Desert in attempt to conquer it for their own. The Song From Before The War described Uzer as the pinnacle of Saradominist civilisation. However, according to some carvings on the temple below the ruins of Uzer, the citizens of Uzer worshipped Saradomin, Zamorak, and Armadyl, so it could be that the religion of Uzer switched many times during the god wars.

Directly to the west of the manor is a compost heap (also a plot device involved in Ernest the Chicken), and a patch of special cabbages. place.title: Ourania Runecrafting Altar
place.summary: It converts pure essence into an assortment of random runes without a chance of bonus runes being created. The altar, which requires no talisman, tiara or staff to enter, gives 1.5x the normal experience for every rune crafted. Players do not need a specific Runecrafting level in order to craft at this altar, but the chance of crafting higher-levelled runes increases with a higher Runecrafting level.

ml.name: the Forgotten Cemetery
ml.text: The ghosts are level 50 monsters, which can be called forth in the Forgotten Cemetery after the Spirit of Summer quest, but they are in the Wilderness. To call forth the ghosts, the player must first close the coffins then use Jennica's ring to enter the spirit realm at the graveyard, open the coffins there, and then leave the spirit realm and repeat after all four are killed. The complexity and tediousness of this makes this highly inefficient both for ghosts Slayer assignment or for profit.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

ml.name: City of Um
ml.text: Ghostly troll bruisers are monsters found inside of the City of Um troll cave, entry from the large cave opening on the south coast of the City of Um. There are seven of them residing within the cave alongside with seven ghostly troll throwers and various other ghostly troll characters.

get_inside.text: To reach the City of Um use:
Underworld portal, just north of the Draynor lodestone. If it hasn't already been completed, the Necromancy! quest will begin upon doing this. The portal takes players to the ritual site in the city.

Teleporting to the Draynor lodestone and then using the Underworld portal is the fastest way to reach the ritual site via the Lodestone Network, for players who are interested in performing rituals efficiently.

Alternatively, for access to a bank while doing rituals, players can use War's Retreat Teleport to go to War's Retreat, exit to Draynor using the exit portal, then enter the ritual site using the Underworld portal.
City of Um lodestone located in the centre, near the bridge towards the ritual site, which can be activated after the introductory quest.
City of Um Teleport to teleport directly to the ritual site, which requires five spirit runes and completion of Rune Mythos.
Underworld Grimoire offers a variety of teleports for completing corresponding tiers of the Underworld achievements:
The Underworld Grimoire 1 has 10 daily teleports to the City of Um smithy.
The Underworld Grimoire 2 adds unlimited teleports to the City of Um smithy and 10 free daily teleports shared between the Um and Ungael ritual sites.
The Underworld Grimoire 3 adds unlimited teleports to the ritual sites.
The Underworld Grimoire 4 adds a daily teleport to Lupe.
Passing bracelet to:
Hanging Gardens, to the east.
Haunt on the Hill, to the north-east near the owlery and the dark portal to the Necromantic Rune Temple.
Reflection Pool, to the south.
Outside of the main district there is a number of other points of interest:
The dark portal to the Necromantic Rune Temple, used to craft the necrotic runes at level 24 Necromancy.

South of the main district and east of the docks is the graveyard, which is where the priestess Selene resides and is able to teach the adventurer necromancy prayers. The graveyard is full of shrines to honour the living; some City of Um residents light candles in these shrines to watch over their living loved ones as they wait for them to pass to the Underworld.
In the graveyard area there's also a troll cave where a variety of ghostly trolls can be killed. The cave also contains the entrance to Trollgrav.
There is a bakery owned by Dominique who sometimes is in town. They ask the player for a century egg, bonemeal, and curdled milk to create a deathday cake as part of a City of Um achievement.

The City of Um is located on Lake Mnemosyne. Players are able to rent boats or get a free boat tour from Ed to explore the lake or learn more about the City of Um. During a boat tour, it is revealed that the many shipwrecks surrounding Um among the jagged rocks in the lake were imagined into existence by the sailors and pirates who passed into the Underworld. Tavia can be spotted fishing on the far eastern shore of Um, visible only from the lake by boat.

The owlery is located in the north-east of the city next to the Haunt on the Hill (dark portal) station of the City of Um ferry system. At level 75 Necromancy new residents are unlocked which include the fallen heroes of the While Guthix Sleeps quest (Turael, Ghommal, Duradel, Sloane, Cyrisus, and Hazelmere) that can be interacted to power the Well of Souls with 150 souls.

The Hanging Gardens are located in the east of the city, east of Kili and south of the dark portal. At 80 Necromancy, a mushroom patch and a compost bin will be functional, and Hemlock, a gardener who functions as a tool leprechaun, and a retired tool leprechaun will also arrive.

place.title: City of Um
place.summary: While the city is only meant for the deceased, the living are able to visit Um under special circumstances. The player is the first human to visit Um after being taken there by Death, Malignius Mortifer was allowed to visit in order to help them train Necromancy, Frank additionally works as an administrator, and Philipe Carnillean was invited for educational purposes after Frank asked Death.

At level 75 Necromancy new residents are unlocked which include the fallen heroes of the While Guthix Sleeps quest (Turael, Ghommal, Duradel, Sloane, Cyrisus, and Hazelmere) that can be interacted to power the Well of Souls with 150 souls.

The Hanging Gardens are located in the east of the city, east of Kili and south of the dark portal. At 80 Necromancy, a mushroom patch and a compost bin will be functional, and Hemlock, a gardener who functions as a tool leprechaun, and a retired tool leprechaun will also arrive.

place.title: City of Um
place.summary: While the city is only meant for the deceased, the living are able to visit Um under special circumstances. The player is the first human to visit Um after being taken there by Death, Malignius Mortifer was allowed to visit in order to help them train Necromancy, Frank additionally works as an administrator, and Philipe Carnillean was invited for educational purposes after Frank asked Death.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
To reach the City of Um use:
• Underworld portal, just north of the Draynor lodestone. If it hasn't already been completed, the Necromancy! quest will begin upon doing this. The portal takes players to the ritual site in the city.
• Teleporting to the Draynor lodestone and then using the Underworld portal is the fastest way to reach the ritual site via the Lodestone Network, for players who are interested in performing rituals efficiently.
• Alternatively, for access to a bank while doing rituals, players can use War's Retreat Teleport to go to War's Retreat, exit to Draynor using the exit portal, then enter the ritual site using the Underworld portal.
• City of Um lodestone located in the centre, near the bridge towards the ritual site, which can be activated after the introductory quest.
• City of Um Teleport to teleport directly to the ritual site, which requires five spirit runes and completion of Rune Mythos.
• Underworld Grimoire offers a variety of teleports for completing corresponding tiers of the Underworld achievements:
• The Underworld Grimoire 1 has 10 daily teleports to the City of Um smithy.
• The Underworld Grimoire 2 adds unlimited teleports to the City of Um smithy and 10 free daily teleports shared between the Um and Ungael ritual sites.
• The Underworld Grimoire 3 adds unlimited teleports to the ritual sites.
• The Underworld Grimoire 4 adds a daily teleport to Lupe.
• Passing bracelet to:
• Hanging Gardens, to the east.
• Haunt on the Hill, to the north-east near the owlery and the dark portal to the Necromantic Rune Temple.
• Reflection Pool, to the south.

getting_there.heading: Other locations
getting_there.text:
Outside of the main district there is a number of other points of interest:

The dark portal to the Necromantic Rune Temple, used to craft the necrotic runes at level 24 Necromancy.

South of the main district and east of the docks is the graveyard, which is where the priestess Selene resides and is able to teach the adventurer necromancy prayers. The graveyard is full of shrines to honour the living; some City of Um residents light candles in these shrines to watch over their living loved ones as they wait for them to pass to the Underworld.

In the graveyard area there's also a troll cave where a variety of ghostly trolls can be killed. The cave also contains the entrance to Trollgrav.

There is a bakery owned by Dominique who sometimes is in town. They ask the player for a century egg, bonemeal, and curdled milk to create a deathday cake as part of a City of Um achievement.

The City of Um is located on Lake Mnemosyne. Players are able to rent boats or get a free boat tour from Ed to explore the lake or learn more about the City of Um. During a boat tour, it is revealed that the many shipwrecks surrounding Um among the jagged rocks in the lake were imagined into existence by the sailors and pirates who passed into the Underworld. Tavia can be spotted fishing on the far eastern shore of Um, visible only from the lake by boat.

The owlery is located in the north-east of the city next to the Haunt on the Hill (dark portal) station of the City of Um ferry system. At level 75 Necromancy new residents are unlocked which include the fallen heroes of the While Guthix Sleeps quest (Turael, Ghommal, Duradel, Sloane, Cyrisus, and Hazelmere) that can be interacted to power the Well of Souls with 150 souls.

The Hanging Gardens are located in the east of the city, east of Kili and south of the dark portal. At 80 Necromancy, a mushroom patch and a compost bin will be functional, and Hemlock, a gardener who functions as a tool leprechaun, and a retired tool leprechaun will also arrive.

get_inside.text: Waterbirth Island
Player can navigate to the Waterbirth Island Dungeon in multiple different ways:
Jarvald at the Rellekka docks can sail the player to the Waterbirth Island from where the dungeon can be accessed by climbing down the ladder.
Mask of the Dagannoth or Helm of the Dagannoth can be used to teleport twice per day, next to the entrance to the dungeon.

Using the Combat portal or the Boss portal, players can teleport to the Dagannoth Kings which is inside of the dungeon.

There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

get_inside.text: ...that leads to a completely flooded cavern.

get_inside.text: There is no direct path to the mine; the fastest method to reach the entrance is to use a Games necklace or Drakan's medallion to teleport to Burgh de Rott and run west. Otherwise, players must travel through Mort Myre Swamp.
Map:Abandoned Mine surface

The mine can be approached from the Mort Myre Swamp to the north. Level 61 feral vampyres infest this path. Follow the mine cart tracks to find the main entrance. Most mine carts can simply be walked around, although one cart near the entrance itself must be climbed over. There are also two cart tunnels near the River Salve, where part of the mine cart tracks temporarily leave the mine. All three of these entrances go to level 1.

There is also a set of stairs to the level 2 of the mine. However, both doors to this room are locked and require the crystal mine key to be unlocked. The player acquires this key during the Haunted Mine quest.

For those who have aided Burgh de Rott in the quest In Aid of the Myreque, a new path opens to the east. Jumping over the low fence (25 Agility required) will bring the player near the mine. Just run west a little and then choose your entrance.
Quick-access (pictured right): This only applies if players have completed the Morytania hard tasks and the Haunted Mine quest.
pic: The shortcut located south-east from the entrance to Tarn's Lair.

get_inside.text: Enter the mine via the main entrance (climb the cart and through the tunnel) and select Crawl-through option on the tunnel at the cart immediately south.
Players who have not completed the hard Morytania achievements and Haunted Mine quest must follow the steps below to obtain the glowing fungus to gain access.
To get to point L on level 4 from the surface (and move a glowing fungus by mine cart):
# Surface: Enter the main entrance.
# Level 1: Go 1 - 3 - 4; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 4 - 6; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 6 - 12; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 12 - J (get fungus) - central K (put fungus in cart) - L. Also go M and N as necessary to set switches correctly. Push 'Start' at L.
To get to point 10 on level 4 from point L (to get the glowing fungus after moving it):
# Level 4: Go L - 12; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 12 - 6; climb up.
# Level 2: Go 6 - 4; climb up.
# Level 1: Go 4 - 3 - 2; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 2 - 7; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 7 - 10; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 10 - K (search cart for fungus).
To get to point 13 on level 5 from point K on level 4 (to get to the mine/collect key):
#Level 4: Go K - 10; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 10 - 9; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 9 - 13; take lift down to level 5.
To get a new crystal-mine key (skip to next group if you have the key):
# Level 5: Go 14; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 14 - T (take innocent-looking key; turns into crystal-mine key, can be added to the key ring).
#Level 6: Go 14; climb up to get back to level 5.
To get to the crystal mine (with the crystal-mine key):
# Level 5: Go 15; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 15 - U (unlock door with key) - Y (crystal mine).

get_inside.text: Taverley
The entrance to the caverns

The entrance to the dungeon is found south of Taverley and west of Falador. After the update UD | Troll Warzone , it was relocated closer to a bank - directly south of the dock past the bridge by the wheat patch. (The boat carries to Daemonheim, and from there to Al Kharid or back to Taverley).

The Obelisk of Water on an island can only be reached by traversing the dungeon. The island is just off the coast near Catherby. There is a one-way mithril grapple shortcut from the island to the shore which requires 36 Agility, 39 Ranged, and 22 Strength.
Taverley Dungeon

place.title: Taverley Dungeon
place.summary: The dungeon has the entrances of two resource dungeons: the hellhound and blue dragon resource dungeon. These require 55 and 60 minimum Dungeoneering levels to enter, respectively. The blue dragon chamber of the dungeon and the resource dungeon accessed from this chamber are the only locations where blue dragon scales (used for Herblore) spawn.

ml.name: Daemonheim
ml.text: A giant bat is an animal found in Daemonheim, on abandoned, furnished, and occult floors. It looks like a bat, but is, as expected, bigger. It doesn't hit particularly hard for its level, but it is very accurate. Its specific elemental weakness varies between individual giant bats.

get_inside.text: Wilderness
Moia, daughter of Lucien and a half-human, delved into Daemonheim in order to find and investigate Bilrach.
pic: Moia, daughter of Lucien and a half-human, delved into Daemonheim in order to find and investigate Bilrach.

get_inside.text: Dungeoneering portal in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas.

Taking the Fremennik ship from south-western Taverley by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir at the docks. Walking through the Wilderness to the east.
War's Retreat Teleport then enter the Shadow Reef boss portal.

Their name is derived from a dangerous creature native to the Gorajo realm.

The entrance to the Barrows
Drakan's medallion, obtained from the The Branches of Darkmeyer quest, has a teleport directly to the Barrows and it can be used to teleport directly south of the Burgh de Rott bank.
Use games necklace teleport to Burgh de Rott and run north-east (requires completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale and combined 500 companion levels from Temple Trekking).
After completing the Nature Spirit quest, the swamp boat can be taken for free to the bridge between Mort'ton and the Barrows.
There is a fairy ring in Mort Myre Swamp that can be used to reach the swamp boat. It can be accessed by code BKR.
After completion of In Search of the Myreque you can use the trapdoor south of the Hair of the Dog in Canifis to access a faster shortcut to the boat.

Once you have completed the encounter of the Barrows Brothers at least once, players can use the boss portal or reaper portal at War's Retreat. Players can also use the combat portal in the Max Guild, which does not require them to have previously killed the boss.
Use the Canifis lodestone or Kharyrll teleport and walk through Mort Myre Swamp – the slowest method is walking through the swamps from Canifis.

There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

get_inside.text: The main entrance to the caves is through the Lumbridge Swamp, located south of Lumbridge. It is located in the centre of the swamp with a icon on the minimap. A rope is required when using this entrance for the first time. The Water altar is near this entrance.

Another route is through the basement of Lumbridge Castle, as the tunnels between the castle and the Dorgesh-Kaan mine also deviate towards the Swamp Caves, directly south from the tunnel entrance in the castle basement. The route between the tunnels and the Swamp Caves is initially blocked and needs to be mined. The Lost Tribe is required to access the tunnels and thus access the Swamp Caves from this direction.
A final route is via teleporting to the Tears of Guthix cavern with a games necklace then heading north.

There are two entrances to the dungeon. The most common is in Edgeville, in the ruins south of the bank. It is marked by a mark on the minimap.

get_inside.text: Sanguinesti region

The northernmost tunnel entrance is in Canifis, through the trapdoor south of the tavern. For those claimed the shortcut reward for training Zachory Bragg to level 99, they can be deactivated the reward by reading the Temple Trekking noticeboard near Paterdomus and selecting the "reward" option on the Zachory's level 99 "Shortcut" reward.
The tunnel entrance at the southern end of the northern section is in Mort Myre Swamp, through the wooden doors south of the tavern.
The southern tunnel entrance is in north-eastern Meiyerditch in the third building from the top along the eastern wall.
The following are other alternative ways to get to there:
Drakan's medallion can teleport players to the laboratory.
The southern tunnel entrance is in north-eastern Meiyerditch in the third building from the top along the eastern wall.
Fairy ring code DLS transports a player to the north-west corner of the tunnels.
Another quick way to get to this tunnels is to go into the abyss, then through the blood altar and exit it to appear in the cave. However, travelling through the abyss will drain a player's prayer.
Use a blood altar teleport tablet to blood altar.
A mask of Broken Fingers or its upgraded version can teleport players to these tunnels twice per day, near the zombie hands.
A mask of Crimson or its upgraded version can teleport players to these tunnels twice per day, near the aggressive mutated bloodvelds.

Players can travel between different sections through the basement wall and then immediately head east through the cave entrance to Ivandis' tomb. Go through the south cave entrance into the tunnels. It requires Agility level 65 to pass through the jutting wall shortcut.

Attempting the north cave entrance before completing the quest In Aid of the Myreque gives the message: You're not sure where this leads to and have an ominous feeling it leads nowhere good. You decide not to go through.

get_inside.text: Misthalin
Varrock east entrance
Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.

Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.

Varrock has four main gates, all of which are open to the public. Each is guarded by several level 36 guards, although they are not aggressive. The north gate can be found near the Wilderness wall and is commonly used by those travelling to Wilderness Crater or exploring the Wilderness. The east gate can be found after following the northern path at the crossroads near northern Al Kharid. The west gate can be reached by travelling east from Gunnarsgrunn. The south gate can be reached by travelling north-west from Lumbridge. Near it is the Stone Circle, where many level 7 and 20 dark wizards can be found.

There are also several other less-official entrances. By travelling north from the road east of the Gunnarsgrunn, players can enter the Grand Exchange, and from there the Varrock Palace grounds. An Agility shortcut north-west of the Grand Exchange can be used by members with 21 agility, running two-way between Varrock and Edgeville.

Outside of The Rusty Anchor Inn
Players can teleport to Port Sarim using the Home Teleport spell once they have activated Port Sarim lodestone.
Port Sarim can be entered by land from Falador to the north/north-west, Draynor Village to the east, Rimmington to the west, or Thurgo's Peninsula to the south.
If a player has the explorer's ring 3 or 4 equipped or in their inventory, they can teleport to the Falador cabbage patch north of the area and walk south.
Players can also travel by ship from Karamja, Crandor, or Entrana, arriving at the dock.

Players can also travel to Port Sarim jail directly from Al Kharid by telling Shantay that they are outlaws. If they disagree to his terms, he will teleport them to Port Sarim jail. They can then pick the lock (both F2P and P2P) in their cell to get out.
Fairy ring (code AIQ) travels to Mudskipper Point, the southern extent of Thurgo's Peninsula, south of Port Sarim.
Using the teleport option on the Arc Journal obtained from Sharkborne. Requires completion of Impressing the Locals.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players can teleport to Port Sarim using the Home Teleport spell once they have activated Port Sarim lodestone.
• Port Sarim can be entered by land from Falador to the north/north-west, Draynor Village to the east, Rimmington to the west, or Thurgo's Peninsula to the south.
• If a player has the explorer's ring 3 or 4 equipped or in their inventory, they can teleport to the Falador cabbage patch north of the area and walk south.
• Players can also travel by ship from Karamja, Crandor, or Entrana, arriving at the dock.
• Players can also travel to Port Sarim jail directly from Al Kharid by telling Shantay that they are outlaws. If they disagree to his terms, he will teleport them to Port Sarim jail. They can then pick the lock (both F2P and P2P) in their cell to get out.
• Fairy ring (code AIQ) travels to Mudskipper Point, the southern extent of Thurgo's Peninsula, south of Port Sarim.

get_inside.text: West of Uzer
Map | mtype=square | 3374,3108 | r=11 | align=right | caption=Location of the tower

Use a Dominion medallion or Super dominion medallion to teleport there. This requires a minimum of being able to compete in the Dominion Tower (at least 20 of the 38 quests completed); if able to compete in the Dominion Tower, one can obtain the medallion on a previous trip to the tower. Both versions of the medallion allows a maximum of three teleports per day to the tower.

If the player's player-owned house is located in the Menaphos Port district or if by using a Menaphos tablet (requires the Love Story quest), players can teleport to Port district's dock, use right-click "Travel" option on Portmaster Kags and choose Dominion Tower, this is one of the quickest ways to get to Dominion Tower. Using the teleport option on a Slayer codex with at least 50 souls added also gets you within a few steps of the Portmaster.

Go through the Shantay Pass, run East-South-East to the River Elid, cross the bridge and go slightly North to reach the tower. The quickest transport to the Pass is by using a broomstick, or a charged Amulet of glory.

Use the Eagle transport system (requires completing the Eagles' Peak quest) or Fairy ring DLQ (requires partial completion of the A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest) to travel to the Uzer Hunter area and run north-west.

Use a Pollnivneach teleport scroll, Pollnivneach tablet (requires completing the Love Story quest) or ring of slaying (requires the ability to purchase or make the ring) to teleport to Pollnivneach, then run north along the River Elid until the bridge, cross that bridge and go north.
Use a Desert amulet 2, 3 or 4's Nardah teleport ability, then run north along the Elid.

place.title: Dominion Tower
place.summary: The Dominion Tower houses a minigame which gives players the opportunity to re-fight various bosses from 60 quests plus a non-quest Dominion Tower boss - Sunfreet. It is located in the northern Kharidian Desert, near the source of the River Elid. The minigame gives rewards including combat experience, new consumable items, and dominion glove sets. In general players use the tower for prestige or to gain its non-tradeable rewards rather than to make money. The history of the Tower is revealed in the Dominion journal, which is acquired as one beats bosses. The tower was constructed by an individual known as The Founder, while a stone face which is said to come from ancient times manages the tower.

ml.name: Temple Trekking
ml.text: The giant snail (Achatina Acidia Giganteus) is a large snail that can be encountered during the Temple Trekking minigame. Wearing a snelm will significantly reduce the amount of damage taken, but this does not affect the accuracy of the snail's attack, although this should not be necessary for high level players. Protect from/Deflect Ranged may be preferable to using a snelm if multiple snails are attacking, especially for low level players.

get_inside.text: Temple Trekking starts at the town of Burgh de Rott by the northern gate. Start the minigame by reading the noticeboard nearby.
Burgh de Rott Ramble starts on the east side of the River Salve just outside Paterdomus. A player can start on either side.
There are several ways to reach Canifis or Burgh de Rott quickly where the minigame may be started. Some of these include:
Drakan's medallion teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).

ml.text: Giant snails will always drop a snail shell when killed, which can be sold to Barlak in Dorgesh-Kaan for 600 coins. There is also a small chance the perfect shell would be dropped instead; the shell can be sold to Barlak for 1,000 coins and 500 Crafting experience.

get_inside.text: There are multiple ways of accessing Dorgesh-Kaan.

Players may enter the crack in the eastern wall of the cellar of Lumbridge Castle, through which Kazgar waits to lead players through the Dorgesh-Kaan mine. The entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan is just to the south-east of where Kazgar leaves the player. To follow Kazgar through the mines, the player is required to bring a light source.
The city can be accessed from the Kalphite Hive through the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon to the south of the city, although a light source is required.

There is a fairy ring in the dungeon to the south with the code AJQ. This may only be used if players have completed A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen up to the point where the fairy ring network is unlocked. A light source is needed in the dungeon. To exit from the dungeon to the city, go east of the ring, then go north, west and again to north until a ladder. Climb up the ladder to the Dorgesh-Kaan course, and climb down the stairs to the north to reach the southern part of the city.

The Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system may be used to travel to Dorgesh-Kaan from Keldagrim by rail (after Another Slice of H.A.M.), and vice versa. The tickets are free; a player need only wait less than a minute in the carriage for the departure. The train station in Keldagrim is located near the blast furnace in the south-east of the city, and the train station in Dorgesh-Kaan is on the floor 2 in the south-west corner of the city.
A player may use a Dorgesh-kaan sphere, obtained from Oldak by giving him molten glass and 2 law runes, for a one-click teleport to the city.

The Feldip Hills are positioned to the south of Yanille and Kandarin and southeast of the Castle Wars arena. They are mostly populated by ogres. The capital of the Feldip Hills is the city of Gu'Tanoth; to the west of Gu'Tanoth is Jiggig. Jiggig is filled with Zogres and Skogres (zombie and skeleton ogres, respectively). In the southern areas is a Hunter training area. After completing the quest Big Chompy Bird Hunting, the hunting area can be used to hunt Chompies. In the south-east of the area is the city of Oo'glog. North-east of Oo'glog, the Monastery of Ascension can be found. Also note, to the west near the coast, north of the fishing spots, is a Death rune spawn. Despite the fact that this area is called Feldip Hills, its middle part consists of jungle and southern part consists of plains with many Eucalyptus trees.

place.title: Draynor Manor
place.summary: In the south-west corner of the property is a fountain, which is a plot device in the Ernest the Chicken quest. Directly to the west of the manor is a compost heap (also a plot device involved in Ernest the Chicken), and a patch of special cabbages. These cabbages are unique in that they boost Defence 1 to 2 levels temporarily. During the course of the Black Knights' Fortress quest, these cabbages are referenced by the witch brewing the "doomsday potion" (incidentally, one cannot use a cabbage from here during the quest - the game will not let players actually ruin the quest). Right next to the cabbages is an evil turnip patch, where members can grow an evil turnip for Summoning. It is the only location to have a nightshade patch, which Ayesha the farmer says is due to the grounds of the manor being "unblessed".

Another entrance is west of the Cooks' Guild near Varrock on the east side of the River Lum. To get in, the player must bring a brass key which can be found in the dungeon. It is useful to players who wish to collect big bones, since it leads right down to a group of Hill Giants and is fairly close to the Varrock bank. Alternatively, members can use the bank in the Cooking guild, which is nearer, provided they have completed the Hard set of the Varrock tasks.

get_inside.text: To enter Lumbridge, players can use the bridge to the east of the town over the River Lum.
From the south, there is a path from Lumbridge Swamp that players can use to enter the town.
From the north, players can cross the bridge leading out from the west of the Champions' Guild and through the Mill Road Mill, heading east along the road.
Players can also, from the west, enter the town through the path leading from Draynor Village passing by the pale wisp colony.
Lumbridge lodestone
pic: The Lumbridge musician entertaining near the River Lum.

get_inside.text: Lumbridge Teleport - Unlike the lodestone, this requires level 31 Magic, a law rune, an earth rune, and three air runes but is faster and does not get interrupted by combat. Casting this spell is a medium Lumbridge achievement, Ease of Access.

Lumbridge teleport tablet - Members have the additional option of using teleport tablets to reach Lumbridge. This works similar to casting the Lumbridge Teleport spell normally but can be used when any spellbook is active and only takes up one inventory space.
Ring of respawn - Can teleport the player to the Lumbridge Castle courtyard.
Canoe - Provided the player has the Woodcutting level required, they may use the system to reach several locations, including Lumbridge.
A boat may be taken from the docks south of Taverley, which places players next to the Lumbridge Sage.

Portal Chamber - Players with at least level 50 Construction can build a Lumbridge Teleportation Portal in the Portal Chamber of their player-owned house. Building the portal requires 100 law runes, 300 air runes, and 100 earth runes.

Death - A method that requires little to no effort and no requirements, dying can send the player back to Lumbridge if they have not selected a different respawn point. Since Lumbridge is unlocked by default, this provides a way to get there with no skills or quests required. Players are, however, strongly recommended to bank any valuable items as they will only keep three (four with Protect item prayer on) items in case they do not reach their gravestone in time.

place.title: Lumbridge
place.summary: It is the first town that new players enter after completing the tutorial, and is home to various low level activities and quests. On the west side of the river the town has a general store, a fishing shop, a market with a bank and Thieving stalls as well as a smithy with a forge and an anvil and an entrance to the Thieves' Guild. The east side primarily features a large cow pen. The river itself has several Fishing spots. The southern part of the town houses a church with a graveyard and an entrance to the Lumbridge Catacombs and a passage to the Lumbridge Swamp. The city of Dorgesh-Kaan can be accessed from the castle's basement. West of the castle lies the Lumbridge forest.

place.summary: The jade vine maze was released on October 2007, along with the Back to my Roots quest. It is located just east of Shilo Village. The maze is heavily featured in the Back to my Roots quest, and the follow-up miniquest One Foot in the Grave. The maze is accessed during the Back to my Roots quest, and completion of the quest is required in order to use the eagle transport system to access the maze.
place.teleport: See getting there section

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Some modes of transportation are:
• Eagle transport system
• Elder divination outfit - Equip the full outfit, right click the head and select "Colony teleport", then select the Gleaming wisps (50+) option and lastly walk south to the maze.
• Shilo Village - walk east from Shilo Village, take the Agility shortcut to the north, walk further north and take another Agility shortcut to the west, and finally walk south to the maze.
• Nature altar teleport and teleport to the nature altar, walk south east.
• Abyss - get to the Nature altar through the Abyss, exit the altar, and walk south-east to the maze. (You can also use a teleport tablet to get to the nature altar.)
• Charter ship to the Shipyard
• Gnome glider to Gandius - south of the Shipyard
• Tai Bwo Wannai teleport and then running south-east from the village.
• Witchdoctor mask or Juju teleport spiritbag to teleport to the Herblore Habitat, walk west, take the Agility shortcut to the north, walk further north and take another Agility shortcut to the west, and finally walk south to the maze.

pic: Entrance to the buried portion of Senntisten

get_inside.text: The Pontifex shadow ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral.

Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door (dungeon), east to the ancient doors (The Empty Throne Room) or north-east to a winch (Senntisten Temple).
Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (Key press | 3 ) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.

The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 scm | Archaeology Archaeology or access to those items.

The boss portal in War's Retreat (requiring at least one kill of Kerapac, the bound, Arch-Glacor or Croesus or the boss portal in the Max Guild (not requiring the kill) can be attuned to teleport the player to one of the fronts of the dungeon.
Dig Site pendant can be used to teleport to the following:
Varrock Dig Site - Archaeologist's workbench & Bank chest, walk north-west to the ancient door.
Senntisten Temple - north-west winch entrance to temple.
Skeletal horror Teleport can be used to teleport to the north-east of the ancient door.

ml.name: Ghorrock
ml.text: Unlike the other mages whose past is completely unknown, part of Glacies' past is revealed in the Virtus book. She accompanied Virtus to Ghorrock to study the local snowfield, where she found strata that leaked strange energy from a concentration of black and purple crystals. Virtus temporarily left her to inspect the other Forinthry fortresses, where she continued her research. When Virtus returned from his inspection, he learned that Glacies offered her life essence to the crystals, much to his disdain, although the energy did remind him of Nex.

get_inside.text: Troll Country
Ghorrock can only be accessed upon reaching a certain stage of The Temple at Senntisten quest.

From the Rellekka Hunter area (fairy ring code: DKS) take the canoe (North-West from fairy ring code: DKS) to the Mahjarrat Ritual Site Cavern, then pass the ice block to the east. A heat globe is needed to pass Ice Block. You do not need a heat globe during Ritual of the Mahjarrat.

After the completion of Ritual of the Mahjarrat, players may use the Glacor Cave (fairy ring code: DKQ) to access Ghorrock instead, gaining the Stone of Jas damage boost in the process. Run north from the ring to the cavern exit, then north again across the ritual site to the tunnel into the wall that leads to Ghorrock. The north side of the tunnel is enclosed by debris and safe from iron dragons.
There are several other less-recommended ways to access this fairly isolated part of the world:
Teleport with either a Mask of Gelatin or Jellyhead, each having a limit of two teleports per day.
Use the Enchanted Lyre to teleport to Rellekka, then run north-east to the Trollweiss Hunter Area then walk north and then west to the canoe, which will take you to Ghorrock Fortress.

Use the Ardougne/Edgeville teleport lever (or walk) to level 56 wilderness. You will also need a sharp object, such as a knife to slash the web. From here run all the way west past the agility course. Requires passing through the deep Wilderness.
Ice Plateau Teleport (Lunar Spellbook). Requires passing through the Wilderness in addition to having level 89 in Magic.
Ghorrock Teleport (Ancient Spellbook). Requires passing through the Wilderness in addition to having level 96 in Magic.
Lava titan teleport to level 40 Wilderness just southeast of the fortress. Requires passing through the Wilderness.

Using the Wilderness Obelisk teleport portals to randomly travel to high level wilderness. If the hard Wilderness achievements have been completed, the player may select the destination themselves, with the level 44 wilderness destination being south-west of Ghorrock, however this requires the player to enter the Wilderness.

The Glacor Cave, which is referred as Saradomin's hidden cave in world map, is an icy underground cavern located near the Mahjarrat Ritual Site. It can be accessed after completion of the Ritual of the Mahjarrat, either through an entrance to the south of the ritual site, via the fairy ring code DKQ, by using the quest cape or by using the master quest cape. It was the cavern in which Lucien stored the Stone of Jas between the events of While Guthix Sleeps and the Ritual of the Mahjarrat.

place.title: Elder God Wars Dungeon
place.summary: The dungeon does not have any requirements to access. However, specific activities or enemies have skill requirements. Completion of Sliske's Endgame and City of Senntisten is recommended to unlock additional rewards and better understand the story. The bosses do not require a killcount and skill requirement to access unlike the previous God Wars dungeons. Wielding the Shard of Erebus, a post-quest reward from the Battle of the Monolith quest, renders the monsters in the dungeon unaggressive. Among the rewards, each front introduced a new god book based on each of the Elder Gods, as well as tier 95 Melee and Magic weapons and tier 90 Magic tank armour. The new weapons marked the first tier 95 weapons in game.

place.title: Monastery of Ascension
place.summary: The main purpose of the dungeon is for hunting the Ascension crossbow. The crossbow is made by combining a dragon crossbow, the six different Ascension signets dropped by the Legiones bosses, and 100 Ascension shards. The Legiones are accessed by using the Ascension Keystones on their individual laboratories. Ascension Keystones are dropped by all monsters in the dungeon, including the Legiones themselves.

ml.name: floating island
ml.text: Glod is a huge, muscular giant who can be found on the floating island at the top of the magic beanstalk in the Grim Tales quest. He uses an extremely accurate melee attack, in which he stomps on the player. Glod has the ability to bellow threats at players to either make them run in fear of the huge giant or charge at him in anger. He can also heal himself similar to the gorillas on Ape Atoll, making him a bit harder to kill. When Glod is killed he drops the golden goblin which is a quest item needed for the Grim Tales quest.

There are several fast ways to get to the dungeon:

place.title: Rellekka Hunter area dungeon
place.summary: The main chamber is full of aggressive gnoeals that attack with magic and yetis that attack with melee. In this dungeon players can easily be attacked by both combat styles at once. The yetis and gnoeals also attack one another and a pair of fighting monsters will ignore the player if the player leaves them alone. If the player attacks one of a fighting pair, the attacked monster will often (not always) switch opponents and target the player. (This has been confirmed for the yetis but not for either the aggressive or non-aggressive gnoeals. Gnoeals will often switch, however, if the player's familiar attacks it.) Sometimes, a monster attacking the player will switch to attack a monster attacking it, although this does not happen as often.

ml.name: Tree Gnome Stronghold floor 1

pic: Tree Gnome Stronghold floor 1 — RuneScape Surface

start_overview: Tree Gnome Stronghold floor 1 — RuneScape Surface

get_inside.text: Tree Gnome Stronghold main gate.

The Spirit tree at the crossroads south of the Grand Tree can be accessed from the Tree Gnome Village — it is on the northwest side, near the small obelisk. The north-east Grand Exchange tree is the easiest access to the network, with the South Feldip Hills tree (use a ring of duelling) or the Port Sarim farming patch tree following in convenience. After the Grand Tree this tree can send the player outwards to any other tree in the network, but incoming players must still go through the Tree Gnome Village hub.
Seed pods from the Gnome Restaurant minigame will instantly summon transport to the Grand Tree. They are consumed after one use.
Hazelmere's signet ring provides an unlimited free teleport (next to Argento and Hazelmere's statue).
Walk through the front gate. The first time you enter there is a small dialogue with Femi. The gate can be reached from the following locations:
A traveller's necklace can be used to teleport to the Outpost. The player can run north-north-east to reach the gate, after a short distance.
North-west from East Ardougne or west from the Fishing Guild — the Ardougne lodestone can be used to get to the guild.

The Gnome glider hub is located on the top level of the Grand Tree. Easiest access to this network is through the Al Kharid lodestone, but this network also connects to the fairy ring network and other useful locations.
There are two Agility shortcuts from nearby areas:
There is a stile over the western fence into the terrorbird pen, which is a short distance south from the Eagles' Peak lodestone. It requires 61 Agility.
With 37 Agility after the The Grand Tree quest: straight into the Grand Tree itself, south-west from Barbarian Assault (by Games necklace).

• Quickest mode of transport is Spirit tree to right beside King Bolren inside the village.
• Other options are the Yanille lodestone, Fairy ring CIQ, Ardougne Monastery teleport on a Ardougne cloak 1, Watchtower Teleport, Castle Wars teleport with a ring of duelling, or Balloon transport system to Castle Wars, then run to the northwest entrance of the maze and 'follow' Elkoy, and 'Squeeze-through' the loose railing to enter the village.

Teleport to Tree Gnome Village and head north
Use the Kandarin monastery Teleport and head west
Teleport to the Battlefield of Khazard using a Spirit tree and head west

place.title: Battlefield
place.summary: The Battlefield is separated by a small river (with three bridges), with the Gnomes on the south side (by Tree Gnome Village), and the Khazard troopers on the north side. This area plays a large role in Tree Gnome Village quest. The gnomes and troopers are often seen to be engaged in battles with each other. Players are free to support either side in the battle.

ml.name: Tree Gnome Stronghold
ml.text: Gnome Drivers are gnomes which ride along with Gnome Mages and Gnome Archers on trained tortoises at the Battlefield and north of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

get_inside.text: Tree Gnome Stronghold main gate.

The Spirit tree at the crossroads south of the Grand Tree can be accessed from the Tree Gnome Village — it is on the northwest side, near the small obelisk. The north-east Grand Exchange tree is the easiest access to the network, with the South Feldip Hills tree (use a ring of duelling) or the Port Sarim farming patch tree following in convenience. After the Grand Tree this tree can send the player outwards to any other tree in the network, but incoming players must still go through the Tree Gnome Village hub.
Seed pods from the Gnome Restaurant minigame will instantly summon transport to the Grand Tree. They are consumed after one use.
Hazelmere's signet ring provides an unlimited free teleport (next to Argento and Hazelmere's statue).
Walk through the front gate. The first time you enter there is a small dialogue with Femi. The gate can be reached from the following locations:
A traveller's necklace can be used to teleport to the Outpost. The player can run north-north-east to reach the gate, after a short distance.
North-west from East Ardougne or west from the Fishing Guild — the Ardougne lodestone can be used to get to the guild.

The Gnome glider hub is located on the top level of the Grand Tree. Easiest access to this network is through the Al Kharid lodestone, but this network also connects to the fairy ring network and other useful locations.
There are two Agility shortcuts from nearby areas:
There is a stile over the western fence into the terrorbird pen, which is a short distance south from the Eagles' Peak lodestone. It requires 61 Agility.
With 37 Agility after the The Grand Tree quest: straight into the Grand Tree itself, south-west from Barbarian Assault (by Games necklace).

place.title: Sophanem
place.summary: Sophanem was founded in the Second Age, shortly before the reign of Pharaoh Queen Senliten. It remained a relatively small village well into the Third Age, at which point the Kharidian Desert Campaign forced refugees from besieged settlements such as Uzer and Ullek to flee further south for survival. This re-location of most of the desert's populace essentially left Sophanem at the Menaphite nation's centre, eventually leading to its incorporation as part of a joint-capital with Menaphos.

get_inside.text: Fairy ring BIQ is quite near the surface entrance to the hive. When travelling through the desert, players should have a water source (like Waterskins) and perhaps wear Desert clothing, to protect against the effects of Desert heat.

Players will need a rope to enter the hive from the surface the first time they come, and another to enter the area containing the Kalphite Queen. Good food and maybe prayer potions are advised if you are to visit the queen.

There is an alternative underground entrance to this dungeon from the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon, which avoids the desert heat and the need for one of the ropes. However, players should have a light source when travelling through the south dungeon. Fairy ring to Dorgesh-Kaan dungeon is AJQ.

ml.name: North of Pollnivneach

get_inside.text: Kharidian Desert
Northern side of the town with a magic carpet, house portal and a small obelisk
pic: Northern side of the town with a magic carpet, house portal and a small obelisk

get_inside.text: Pollnivneach Teleport scroll takes user directly into the city.
Using the magic carpet network to one of two magic carpet stations in the city. South Pollnivneach is also one of the two destinations of the Monkey colony magic carpet route.
House Teleport, if players have their house portal in Pollnivneach, they can use the spell to reach their house and then exit through the portal.
Pollnivneach tablet, if the Love Story quest has been completed.
Ring of slaying, Slayer cape or Slayer master cape teleport to the house of slayer master Sumona.
The Mask of Mourning and Helm of Keening can teleport user to the Pollnivneach well.
The master camouflage outfit offers unlimited teleports to Pollnivneach, just north-east of the well.
Walking south/south-east from the Shantay Pass.
Using the ferryman, Portmaster Kags, in the south-western corner of the Menaphos Port district.
Other ways to reach the city indirectly. These methods first go to nearby locations to speed up the journey, and then use the above methods to reach Pollnivneach:

There are some fairy rings somewhat near Pollnivneach. Ring DLQ is in the Uzer Hunter area near Nardah; from there either use the Nardah carpet or walk north-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and then walk south-west to the city. Ring BIQ is near the entrance to the Kalphite Lair; from there use the Shantay Pass carpet or walk east/south-east to the city.

The eagle transport system flies to a cave near the Uzer Hunter area, like the fairy ring DLQ. From there, either walk south-east to Uzer and use the carpet, or walk south-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and walk south-west to Pollnivneach.
The Dorgesh-Kaan shortcut in the dungeon beneath the agility course leads to the Kalphite Lair and from there has the same routes as Fairy Ring code BIQ.
The camulet from Enakhra's Lament teleports to the underground Enakhra's Temple. Climb out from there and walk east to the city.

The Pharaoh's sceptre from the Pyramid Plunder minigame teleports to any of three pyramids: Jalsavrah Pyramid is in Sophanem; from there take the carpet or walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaleustrophos Pyramid is the Agility Pyramid; from there either walk northeast to Nardah and take the carpet, or walk north-west to the lower river bridge, cross it and walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaldraocht Pyramid is also called Azzanadra's pyramid from the Desert Treasure quest; from there walk east or northeast to Pollnivneach.

The entrance to the Underground Pass
pic: The entrance to the Underground Pass

get_inside.text: The following only contains information on how to get through the pass after the quest is done.
pic: A pit full of spikes within the Underground Pass

get_inside.text: The player will not be able to enter Iban's Temple and the elven lands until the player has spoken to King Lathas at the start of Regicide. The player's quest journal will mention about assassinating his brother if they have talked to him.
Travelling through Underground path
To go through the path, it is recommended to have a high Agility level. A Thieving level of 50 is another advantage.
These items are needed:
A rope (bring more if the Agility level is low)
A shortbow (chargebow will not work)
A few of bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon, or dark arrows (bring a few extras should you do so; no advantage in type)
Food to survive traps and monsters
Part 1
Checklist | * Enter the pass through the cave entrance in West Ardougne.
Simply walk around the swamp and do not attempt to cross the bubbles in the cave.
Talk to Koftik, and he will give you a damp cloth.
Use it on an arrow to change it to a fire arrow.

Light this arrow. It is possible to miss arrows in the next steps, so you may need to make more. Only make one at a time because you can not light these arrows if there is more than one in your inventory.
Go to the north.
Equip the bow and fire at the guide rope with the lit fire arrow, and you will automatically cross the bridge.
Once you have crossed the bridge, you may be attacked by level 42 blessed spiders if you are under level #expr:42*2 Combat. Stay away from the small rooms to the north and south to avoid them.
Now, go to the little chamber to the north and pick up a plank.
Continue going south, then east.

Use a rope on an old spike on the ground on your side next to the north gap. It is possible to fail this part and lose your rope, so bringing multiple ropes is a good precaution. If you do fall, you will have to navigate a rock maze to get out. You will end up at the beginning of the pass, and you'll have to start with firing at the guide rope again. The old spike is very small and slightly below ground level. It may be necessary to point your camera west and zoom very far in to see it.
Continue following the path and climb over two rockslides.

You will come to a grid of spike traps. For each person the path to cross these is different, so it is suggested that once you find your path, you write it down somewhere. You could already have figured out which path is safe for you while doing the quest Underground Pass. The area prevents you from using abilities like Surge.
Pathmap | 5 | 5 | id=Underground Pass

Checklist | * Once past the spike traps, pull the lever to the south and the portcullis will rise. Do not take the obstacle pipe because it's only one-way and you will have to redo guide rope obstacle.
After passing the gate, you should be in a room full of zombies. Head west past the furnace.

Continue going west, and as you run past the spear wall traps, you might take some damage. If you have a good Thieving level you can try to disable them by searching the odd markings on the wall. You may take multiple triple-digit damage per trap if you try to run past without disabling them. Area prevents you from using abilities like Surge so it is best to disarm the traps. Search on the odd markings on the wall, then run two tiles ahead of you. With run active, your character will run past the wall trap without activating it. You'll only take damage if you run across them all at once.
Next, climb down the well.
Part 2
Checklist | * Head west towards the cages of slaves.
Enter the south-east cage and dig up the mud. This will take you to the back of the cage.
Follow the path and cross the ledge (if you fail, you will reach back to the cell area).
In the next area you have a couple choices.

If you have 50 Thieving, you may pick the locks on two cages by following the southward path. Once past the cage, make sure you don't step on the bubbles, or you'll have to start back at the beginning.
Otherwise, head onto the wooden bridges, balancing over the narrow parts. Take the right path, left, then finally, the left again. The higher your Agility level, the less your chance of failing it.
Whichever path you took, follow the path to the south and squeeze through the pipe.
Part 3
Checklist | * Go past the smashed cage and pass through the tunnel on the north side of the cave.
Follow the passage until you pass the zombies and see paladins.
Use the plank found earlier on either one of the flat rock traps to get past.
Continue forward, open the door, and you will be standing in Iban's lair.
Travelling to the end of Underground Pass in Iban's lair
Checklist | * After entering, head as far south (past the bridges and walkways) as you can. Along the back wall, you'll find stairs.
Descend the cave stairs (this will take you to "Beneath Iban's Lair" as shown on the world map).
If you need food, talk to Kamen the dwarf in the southwest corner of the cave.
Decline or accept Kamen's brew, but note that it will lower your Agility, potentially heightening your chances of falling into the abyss in the next step.
After declining or accepting, Kamen will offer to sell you food for 75 coins.
Proceed to the northwest corner until you find cave stairs that can be ascended.
Ascend the stairs.
If at any point you fall during the next steps, these stairs are where you'll go to return to Iban's Lair and try again.
Heading south, cross the third walkway.
Jump over the bridge to the first platform.
From the first platform, go southeast to a second platform.
From the second platform, take the eastern path over a winding bridge to the third platform. There should be some red-cloaked Disciples of Iban on this platform.
Proceed south for a bridge jump.
Take the western path closest to the Temple of Iban stairs.
Open the temple door.
Doing so will unlock the Well of Voyage music track.
You can talk to Koftik here if you have completed the Underground Pass quest, who will give you some food if you were hurt by the traps.
Climb-down the well.
Head west past the glowing obelisks and exit the cave.

start_overview: West of the Fishing Guild — Hemenster

get_inside.text: Hemenster
The main entrance hall
The Fishing Guild is located south-west of Seers' Village and north of Ardougne, in the village of Hemenster. There are several transportation options:
Use a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the Guild door.
Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone and run north.
Teleport to the Seers' Village lodestone and follow the road south-west past the Ranging Guild.
Use the Lunar spell Fishing Guild Teleport, or get teleported by someone casting Tele-group Fishing Guild.
Use a combat bracelet to teleport to the Ranging Guild and head west.

Break a plain of mud sphere to be teleported to the Goblin Cave (the dungeon area just south-east of the guild), exit through the entrance, and head west. This requires completion of the Land of the Goblins quest, however.

Here is a range which players can use to cook food. It is fairly close to a bank. However, many players go to cook next to the bank in the Rogues' Den, since there is an everlasting fire next to the banker, or in the Cooking Guild with varrock armour 3. A lobster pot, harpoon, and big fishing net spawn here. There is also a staircase that leads to the floor 2, which contains a bed for the employee. Clear

The Fishing Guild is located south-west of Seers' Village and north of Ardougne, in the village of Hemenster. There are several transportation options:
• Use a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the Guild door.
• Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone and run north.
• Teleport to the Seers' Village lodestone and follow the road south-west past the Ranging Guild.
• Use the Lunar spell Fishing Guild Teleport, or get teleported by someone casting Tele-group Fishing Guild.
• Use a combat bracelet to teleport to the Ranging Guild and head west.
• Break a plain of mud sphere to be teleported to the Goblin Cave (the dungeon area just south-east of the guild), exit through the entrance, and head west. This requires completion of the Land of the Goblins quest, however.

getting_there.heading: Entrance hall
getting_there.text:
Here is a range which players can use to cook food. It is fairly close to a bank. However, many players go to cook next to the bank in the Rogues' Den, since there is an everlasting fire next to the banker, or in the Cooking Guild with varrock armour 3. A lobster pot, harpoon, and big fishing net spawn here. There is also a staircase that leads to the floor 2, which contains a bed for the employee. Clear

Players can teleport to Port Sarim using the Home Teleport spell once they have activated Port Sarim lodestone.
Port Sarim can be entered by land from Falador to the north/north-west, Draynor Village to the east, Rimmington to the west, or Thurgo's Peninsula to the south.
If a player has the explorer's ring 3 or 4 equipped or in their inventory, they can teleport to the Falador cabbage patch north of the area and walk south.
Players can also travel by ship from Karamja, Crandor, or Entrana, arriving at the dock.

Players can also travel to Port Sarim jail directly from Al Kharid by telling Shantay that they are outlaws. If they disagree to his terms, he will teleport them to Port Sarim jail. They can then pick the lock (both F2P and P2P) in their cell to get out.

get_inside.text: Misthalin
Varrock east entrance
Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.

Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.

Varrock has four main gates, all of which are open to the public. Each is guarded by several level 36 guards, although they are not aggressive. The north gate can be found near the Wilderness wall and is commonly used by those travelling to Wilderness Crater or exploring the Wilderness. The east gate can be found after following the northern path at the crossroads near northern Al Kharid. The west gate can be reached by travelling east from Gunnarsgrunn. The south gate can be reached by travelling north-west from Lumbridge. Near it is the Stone Circle, where many level 7 and 20 dark wizards can be found.
Varrock east entrance.png | Varrock east entrance
Varrock south entrance.png | Varrock south entrance
Varrock north entrance.png | Varrock north gate

There are also several other less-official entrances. By travelling north from the road east of the Gunnarsgrunn, players can enter the Grand Exchange, and from there the Varrock Palace grounds. An Agility shortcut north-west of the Grand Exchange can be used by members with 21 agility, running two-way between Varrock and Edgeville.
West of Varrock

It is the largest city for non-members and one of largest cities overall.

The Dig Site pendant is a fast way offering 3 locations around the Dig Site:
The Dig Site option places the player in front of the Archaeology Guild.
The Senntisten option in the north-east of the Dig Site near the winch.
The Exam Centre option south of the Dig Site inside the Exam Centre.
The Archaeology journal will teleport the player in front of the Archaeology Guild.
Players can use the earth altar teleport to teleport to the earth altar and run south-east.
Open the invitation box to teleport to the Empyrean Citadel, then open the Invitation Box while in the Empyrean Citadel to teleport to Brother Samwell, then run southwest to the Varrock Dig Site.

Players can use the elder divination outfit to teleport to the nearby bright wisp colony and run east.

start_overview: Entrance to tunnels from Meiyerditch — Sanguinesti region

get_inside.text: Sanguinesti region

The northernmost tunnel entrance is in Canifis, through the trapdoor south of the tavern. For those claimed the shortcut reward for training Zachory Bragg to level 99, they can be deactivated the reward by reading the Temple Trekking noticeboard near Paterdomus and selecting the "reward" option on the Zachory's level 99 "Shortcut" reward.
The tunnel entrance at the southern end of the northern section is in Mort Myre Swamp, through the wooden doors south of the tavern.
The southern tunnel entrance is in north-eastern Meiyerditch in the third building from the top along the eastern wall.
The following are other alternative ways to get to there:
Drakan's medallion can teleport players to the laboratory.
The southern tunnel entrance is in north-eastern Meiyerditch in the third building from the top along the eastern wall.
Fairy ring code DLS transports a player to the north-west corner of the tunnels.
Another quick way to get to this tunnels is to go into the abyss, then through the blood altar and exit it to appear in the cave. However, travelling through the abyss will drain a player's prayer.
Use a blood altar teleport tablet to blood altar.
A mask of Broken Fingers or its upgraded version can teleport players to these tunnels twice per day, near the zombie hands.
A mask of Crimson or its upgraded version can teleport players to these tunnels twice per day, near the aggressive mutated bloodvelds.

Players can travel between different sections through the basement wall and then immediately head east through the cave entrance to Ivandis' tomb. Go through the south cave entrance into the tunnels. It requires Agility level 65 to pass through the jutting wall shortcut.

Attempting the north cave entrance before completing the quest In Aid of the Myreque gives the message: You're not sure where this leads to and have an ominous feeling it leads nowhere good. You decide not to go through.

The God Wars Dungeon (often abbreviated as GWD), originally known as the Temple of Lost Ancients, is a dangerous dungeon where armies of various gods, left over from the God Wars, fight one another to the death. Its release was announced in the Behind the Scenes of August 2007.

place.title: Lumbridge
place.summary: It is the first town that new players enter after completing the tutorial, and is home to various low level activities and quests. On the west side of the river the town has a general store, a fishing shop, a market with a bank and Thieving stalls as well as a smithy with a forge and an anvil and an entrance to the Thieves' Guild. The east side primarily features a large cow pen. The river itself has several Fishing spots. The southern part of the town houses a church with a graveyard and an entrance to the Lumbridge Catacombs and a passage to the Lumbridge Swamp. The city of Dorgesh-Kaan can be accessed from the castle's basement. West of the castle lies the Lumbridge forest.

place.title: Burthorpe
place.summary: The Troll Country is immediately north of Burthorpe, and due to that, the city has come under constant attacks, raids, and invasions by the trolls, having led to the Burthorpe - Troll Country War. Death Plateau in particular seems a threat, as many heavily armed trolls have a permanent camp there. The Imperial Guard, with help of adventurers, has been taking measures to reduce this threat. Trolls are often seen invading the town, slaughtering families and soldiers alike. If the trolls were to overrun Burthorpe, Falador will use it as a reason to disband the Imperial Guard and the town would come under control of the White Knights. Commander Denulth considers the White Knights to be taking advantage of King Vallance, who he describes as "old and weak".

place.title: Goblin Raids
place.summary: Players must kill all 10 raiders in order to fight Hollowtoof. As they are not aggressive, you may kill them one by one. All raiders along with Hollowtoof use melee, and they can be tough for low- to medium-levelled players, so it is recommended to safe spot them if possible. They are weakest against Magic. They also have a small wander radius and will retreat when attacked from outside of it. Thus, it is possible to pin them on an obstacle while they are retreating with a long attack range (any Magic spell, longbows).

get_inside.text: Sophanem
The dungeon is accessed via the dungeon entrance south of the temple of Icthlarin. It can be easily reached through the following methods:
The fastest method is to use a Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablet. The ability to craft them is gained upon reaching rank 4 with any of the Menaphos factions.
Leela's favour provides unlimited teleports to the dungeon entrance.
The Mask of dust (or its transformed variant) can provide two free teleports to the entrance each day, assuming that the player has level 97 Slayer.
Use the Menaphos lodestone, go through the gate connecting the two cities, and run south-east. Using this method requires completion of Contact!.
Teleport to the Luminous wisp colony south of Sophanem via the full Elder divination outfit or a skill portal in the Max garden and head north.
Teleport to the Pyramid Plunder entrance in north Sophanem via the full Master camouflage outfit and head south.
Take a magic carpet flight to Sophanem. Upon arrival, run south and the enter the gate.
There are several access points to the magic carpet network, including:
Shantay Pass to southern Pollnivneach to Sophanem
Ring of slaying or the Slayer cape perk to Sumona in Pollnivneach and then run south to southern Pollnivneach.
Pollnivneach tablet and then run south to southern Pollnivneach.
