get_inside.text: The entrance to Kuradal's Dungeon is a cave near Kuradal in the Ancient Cavern. She is located in the back of the dungeon, on the opposite side of the whirlpool entrance, and up the stairs.
There are four ways to get to the entrance:
Using a ferocious ring to teleport to Kuradal.
Using a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Kuradal.

Entering the Ancient Cavern via the lake above Baxtorian Falls, at the head of the River Dougne. To enter the cavern, players must jump off the dock on the north side of the lake into the whirlpool (followers such as pets or familiars cannot be out at this time). To be able to enter this way, players must have completed Barbarian Training up to the pyre ships part of barbarian Firemaking. One fast way to get to the dock is to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace or Barbarian Teleport (Lunar spellbook).

Use Fairy ring code BJQ to teleport to the Ancient Cavern. Partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings, and the ring in the cavern must first be repaired before it can be used. This is done by using 5 bittercap mushrooms and a spade on the inner ring.
Kuradal's Dungeon

place.title: Kuradal's Dungeon

The aggressive monsters can attack players, but players cannot retaliate unless the monster is part of the assignment. The ferocious ring can be obtained as a drop from these monsters, which has multiple passive effects when equipped while inside the dungeon.

place.title: Ogre Enclave
place.summary: The Ogre Enclave is a dungeon located in Gu'Tanoth. It requires partial completion of the Watchtower quest to enter. The entrance to the enclave is in the western part of the ogre marketplace in the centre of Gu'Tanoth. During the quest, the player must use a cave nightshade on the ogre guard to gain entry. get_inside.text: Karamja
The entrance to Brimhaven Dungeon
The dungeon is located a short distance north-west of the Karamja lodestone. There are also other ways to get there, which are generally obsolete since the introduction of the lodestone:
It be reached by sailing from East Ardougne to Brimhaven, for a fee of 30 coins, 15 with Karamja gloves 1 or for free with the ring of charos.
Another sea route can be taken from Port Sarim to Musa Point, for the same price. However, it is a much longer walk to the dungeon entrance from Musa Point than from Brimhaven.
Alternatively, players can charter a ship to get to Brimhaven (e.g. the Port Sarim-Brimhaven charter ship ride costs 1,600 coins).
Teleportation is also practical:
Players with level 99 Dungeoneering can use the Dungeoneering cape's perk to teleport to the Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon after having accessed it first through other means.
House Teleport if the player-owned house is on Karamja or a Brimhaven tablet if the player has completed Love Story.
Teleport to the Karamja lodestone, which is located directly south-east of the dungeon.
Spirit tree if the player can plant a spirit tree behind the Brimhaven Agility Arena.
Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run west then south.
Fairy ring CKR and then north to the dungeon.
Use of Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport scrolls, a reward from Treasure Trails.

The nearest bank, although the quest Shilo Village and 10 extra coins are required, is Shilo Village bank by using Hajedy's cart. However, one would normally teleport to a bank and return via the the Karamja lodestone.

place.title: Dungeon of Disorder
place.summary: The founder and first hierophant of the Order, Duchess Philippa Wharton, speaks of the dungeon as the base for the reconstruction of a 'gate' that once was located on the northern outskirts of Senntisten. The members of the order were first tasked with breaking down the ruins of the original gate and transferring them, piece by piece, to the dungeon to be gathered before ultimately being sent to the Source through a ritual circle. After the construction, the dungeon was primarily used to imprison kidnapped victims who were forced to accept 'gifts' from the Source or be sacrificed to the demon Dagon. It is thought that these gifts were in fact Avernic demons, who were summoned through the Source from their homeworld, Infernus, to aid in the collapse of Senntisten.

• Take a canoe to the Wilderness pond then run south and use one of the northern entrances to the crater.
• Teleport to the level 35 obelisk using the obelisk network or a portable obelisk.
• Use the Earth altar teleport, Varrock Teleport spell or the Edgeville lodestone, running through the Wilderness and using the southeastern entrance of the crater.
• Use the Wilderness sword 4, teleport to the herb patch and run south.

Regardless of the method of travel, players opted into PvP may be attacked by player killers while in the Wilderness.

get_inside.text: The entrance to Kuradal's Dungeon is a cave near Kuradal in the Ancient Cavern. She is located in the back of the dungeon, on the opposite side of the whirlpool entrance, and up the stairs.
There are four ways to get to the entrance:
Using a ferocious ring to teleport to Kuradal.
Using a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Kuradal.

Entering the Ancient Cavern via the lake above Baxtorian Falls, at the head of the River Dougne. To enter the cavern, players must jump off the dock on the north side of the lake into the whirlpool (followers such as pets or familiars cannot be out at this time). To be able to enter this way, players must have completed Barbarian Training up to the pyre ships part of barbarian Firemaking. One fast way to get to the dock is to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace or Barbarian Teleport (Lunar spellbook).

Use Fairy ring code BJQ to teleport to the Ancient Cavern. Partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings, and the ring in the cavern must first be repaired before it can be used. This is done by using 5 bittercap mushrooms and a spade on the inner ring.
Kuradal's Dungeon

place.title: Kuradal's Dungeon
place.summary: Once in the dungeon, players can only attack the Slayer monster they were assigned, and only while the task has not been completed. All monsters in the dungeon except dark beasts, greater demons, hellhounds, and gargoyles are non-aggressive. The aggressive monsters can attack players, but players cannot retaliate unless the monster is part of the assignment. The ferocious ring can be obtained as a drop from these monsters, which has multiple passive effects when equipped while inside the dungeon.

place.title: Ogre Enclave
place.summary: The Ogre Enclave is a dungeon located in Gu'Tanoth. It requires partial completion of the Watchtower quest to enter. The entrance to the enclave is in the western part of the ogre marketplace in the centre of Gu'Tanoth. During the quest, the player must use a cave nightshade on the ogre guard to gain entry. After the quest, this is no longer required. The cave contains the crystals for the Watchtower quest.

get_inside.text: Karamja
The entrance to Brimhaven Dungeon
The dungeon is located a short distance north-west of the Karamja lodestone. There are also other ways to get there, which are generally obsolete since the introduction of the lodestone:
It be reached by sailing from East Ardougne to Brimhaven, for a fee of 30 coins, 15 with Karamja gloves 1 or for free with the ring of charos.
Another sea route can be taken from Port Sarim to Musa Point, for the same price. However, it is a much longer walk to the dungeon entrance from Musa Point than from Brimhaven.
Alternatively, players can charter a ship to get to Brimhaven (e.g. the Port Sarim-Brimhaven charter ship ride costs 1,600 coins).
Teleportation is also practical:
Players with level 99 Dungeoneering can use the Dungeoneering cape's perk to teleport to the Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon after having accessed it first through other means.
House Teleport if the player-owned house is on Karamja or a Brimhaven tablet if the player has completed Love Story.
Teleport to the Karamja lodestone, which is located directly south-east of the dungeon.
Spirit tree if the player can plant a spirit tree behind the Brimhaven Agility Arena.
Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run west then south.
Fairy ring CKR and then north to the dungeon.
Use of Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport scrolls, a reward from Treasure Trails.

The nearest bank, although the quest Shilo Village and 10 extra coins are required, is Shilo Village bank by using Hajedy's cart. However, one would normally teleport to a bank and return via the the Karamja lodestone.
Brimhaven Dungeon

place.title: Wilderness Crater
place.summary: The crater is now home to many monsters, consisting of ankou, skeletons, hellhounds, greater demons, and lesser demons. The undead roam around the northern area of the crater, while the demons roam the southern area - hellhounds in the middle, lesser demons to the south-west and greater demons to the south-east. The entire crater is a multi-way combat area for the purposes of player versus player combat.

get_inside.text: Wilderness
The fastest way to get here is to use the Annakarl Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook.

Use an Obelisk (Wilderness) to teleport to the obelisk located near the Rogues' Castle in level 50 Wilderness, then run south east through the gate and continue west. Those with a Wilderness sword 3 or better may choose to be teleported to this obelisk directly. Otherwise, teleports are random and it may take several tries to reach this specific obelisk.

An alternative is to teleport using a boss portal or the chest found at any of the elite dungeon locations to the Dragonkin Laboratory and then walk out from there, this also provides quick banking in a safe area by Edward, but this area cannot be re-entered if in combat.
Demonic Ruins (level 47 Wilderness)

place.title: Demonic Ruins
place.summary: The Demonic Ruins are the remains of Annakarl, located deep in the Wilderness. The Ruins are inhabited by greater demons and several burnt bone spawns. In members' worlds, Kal'gerion demons and a lone blood rune spawn are present. A large horde of Ripper Demons are also present west of the ruins, and to the east a large number of Greater demon berserkers and Greater demon ash lords.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

ml.name: The Zamorakian Undercity
ml.text: Greater demon brutes are monsters released with The Zamorakian Undercity.

get_inside.text: Imp scavenger, level 126
The entrance to the dungeon is located east of the pulley, which is used to enter Senntisten behind the Ancient door just north of the Archaeology Guild.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
Use the Pontifex Shadow Ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, to teleport to Senntisten, run north to the Pulley.

Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door (dungeon), east to the ancient doors (The Empty Throne Room) or north-east to a winch (Senntisten Temple).
Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (Key press | 3 ) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.

The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology or access to those items.
Dig site pendant can be used to teleport to the following:
Varrock Dig Site - Archaeologist's workbench & Bank chest, walk north-west to the ancient door.
Senntisten Temple - north-west winch entrance to temple.
Skeletal horror Teleport or invitation box can be used to teleport to the north-east of the ancient door.
Teleport to Earth altar, or using Fort Forinthry Teleport to the north-west of the ancient door.
Ride the balloon to Varrock to the north-west of the ancient door.

Use the Ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select The Zamorakian Undercity (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).
Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside Temple of Aminishi, The Shadow Reef, or the Dragonkin Laboratory (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).

place.title: The Zamorakian Undercity
place.summary: While it is considered an Elite Dungeon (with its own luck charms and ability to teleport to the other Elite Dungeons) it is noticeably different compared to the previous three; the health of enemies scales to the party size (and are also more dangerous) and its luck charm costs slightly more and cannot be converted. It also possesses an enrage system that goes up in intervals of 100% past 4,000% enrage, and the enemies' strengths, types, and quantities begin to change as it increases, capping at 60,000%. Players are free to choose their enrage from 0 to 4,000%. Clearing the undercity increases the rewards obtained from Zamorak.

ml.name: Wilderness threat system
ml.text: There used to be a version that spawned in the Wilderness with sufficiently high threat as part of the ambush mobs, but they are no longer present in the Wilderness following the removal of the threat system on 13 March 2023. The NPCs remain in the game cache.

place.title: Wilderness threat system
place.summary: The Wilderness threat system was added to Wilderness on 1 August 2022 as part of a massive update. Following the conclusion of the battle with Zamorak, the Wilderness has become an increasingly dangerous place. A threat level was the measurement of the system, which slowly accumulates over time, or faster if the player performs various activities in the Wilderness. To prevent the area from being completely AFK, various threats were added in the form of damaging projectiles and flash mobs that increase in frequency the higher the player's threat is.

ml.name: The Zamorakian Undercity
ml.text: Greater demon sages are monsters released with The Zamorakian Undercity.

get_inside.text: Imp scavenger, level 126
The entrance to the dungeon is located east of the pulley, which is used to enter Senntisten behind the Ancient door just north of the Archaeology Guild.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
Use the Pontifex Shadow Ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, to teleport to Senntisten, run north to the Pulley.

Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door (dungeon), east to the ancient doors (The Empty Throne Room) or north-east to a winch (Senntisten Temple).
Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (Key press | 3 ) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.

The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology or access to those items.
Dig site pendant can be used to teleport to the following:
Varrock Dig Site - Archaeologist's workbench & Bank chest, walk north-west to the ancient door.
Senntisten Temple - north-west winch entrance to temple.
Skeletal horror Teleport or invitation box can be used to teleport to the north-east of the ancient door.
Teleport to Earth altar, or using Fort Forinthry Teleport to the north-west of the ancient door.
Ride the balloon to Varrock to the north-west of the ancient door.

Use the Ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select The Zamorakian Undercity (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).
Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside Temple of Aminishi, The Shadow Reef, or the Dragonkin Laboratory (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).

place.title: The Zamorakian Undercity
place.summary: While it is considered an Elite Dungeon (with its own luck charms and ability to teleport to the other Elite Dungeons) it is noticeably different compared to the previous three; the health of enemies scales to the party size (and are also more dangerous) and its luck charm costs slightly more and cannot be converted. It also possesses an enrage system that goes up in intervals of 100% past 4,000% enrage, and the enemies' strengths, types, and quantities begin to change as it increases, capping at 60,000%. Players are free to choose their enrage from 0 to 4,000%. Clearing the undercity increases the rewards obtained from Zamorak.

get_inside.text: Piscatoris
Phoenix Lair is near the Piscatoris Fishing Colony. Players can get to the area by walking or one of these methods:

Use the Phoenix Lair Teleport scroll obtained from Treasure Trails. It takes players to the entrance of the lair, and is very cheap at NoCoins | GE price | c . This is the fastest method to get to the lair.
Teleport using the ability of the Mask of the Airut.
Take the rowboat near the Eagles' Peak lodestone, west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Use fairy ring AKQ - Kandarin: Piscatoris Hunter area - (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen). The closest bank is northwest of the master fairy ring in Zanaris.
Teleport to the Piscatoris Hunter area using a spirit kyatt's ability (requires Summoning level 57 and a spirit kyatt pouch).
Use the teleport from memory strands located in the currency pouch and walk north. There is also a bank nearby.
Teleport to the Piscatoris elder tree via the nature's sentinel outfit and then head west.

getting_there.text:

• At level 17 Wilderness, east of the Bandit Camp and Dark Warriors' Fortress and west of the south-western Wilderness Crater steps. The Wilderness sword 2 (and higher variants) provides free infinite teleports here, and it is a short run west from the Wilderness Crater lodestone.

pics: The entrance to the Forinthry Dungeon.

get_inside.text: Cave bugs, level 6 and 11
There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

The Chaos Tunnels are a large dungeon network located in low-level Wilderness, north of Edgeville. It is in a members-only region. It does not require any quests to be accessed. If players attempt to exit the Chaos Tunnels while opted into PvP, they will receive a warning prompt about it before they can continue.

• Dungeoneering master cape

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
• North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
• East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
• North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
• North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
• North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

The entrance area of The Heart
pic: The entrance area of The Heart

get_inside.text: Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.

The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros
Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.
Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.

pic: Polypore Dungeon — East of the Mage Training Arena

start_overview: Polypore Dungeon — East of the Mage Training Arena

get_inside.text: East of the Mage Training Arena
The cave entrance to the Polypore Slayer Dungeon can be found on a small island located in the River Salve, between Mort Myre Swamp and Al Kharid. Players can access it by:
Using the fairy ring code BIP. This is the fastest way to get there if a player has died, assuming the player has a quick method to reach a fairy ring and does not need the dramen staff.
Using a Dig Site pendant and teleporting to the Exam Centre and running south-east.
Using the Archaeology journal teleport and running south-east.
Running north past the Mage Training Arena (along the east side) by Al Kharid. One of the quickest ways to get to the arena using the Het's Oasis teleport ability of a ring of duelling.
Using the Mask of the Ganodermic or Helm of the Ganodermic to teleport to the bottom floor, very close to the Ramokee Skinweaver.
Using the Dungeoneering Cape, Dungeoneering master cape or hoardstalker ring to teleport to the area (0,7).
Using a delver's anklet (or a suitably charged passage of the abyss) to teleport to the third level.
Polypore Dungeon

The Polypore Dungeon is a very deep Slayer Dungeon located under an island in the River Salve, east of the Mage Training Arena and Exam Centre. Out of boredom, she created the monsters that inhabit the dungeon using the local fungi.

get_inside.text: Karamja
The Brimhaven bar
Brimhaven is located immediately north of the Karamja lodestone.

Brimhaven has a ship ride that will take the player to Ardougne for the low price of 30 coins. This ship is located in the northern part of Brimhaven. The price is lowered to 15 coins after completing the Easy Karamja achievements. Wearing a Ring of charos (a) will allow you to travel to and from Brimhaven for free.
The charter ships also dock in the Brimhaven Harbour. They provide rides to several other locations, for a fee.
If you have completed the Shilo Village quest, then Hajedy will take you for a ride in his cart to Shilo Village for the fee of 10-200 coins.

The House Teleport spell can be used if player-owned house is in Brimhaven. If the Love Story quest has been completed, players can use a Brimhaven tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to House tablet) to teleport to the Brimhaven house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.
The amulet of glory teleport to Musa Point, east of Brimhaven.

If the Holy Grail and A Fairy Tale Part II quests are completed, the Fisher Realm can be reached through the fairy ring system by using code BJR. Use the magic whistle, found at the northwest corner of the Fisher Realm, to exit the Fisher Realm and end up on the northwestern peninsula near the gold mine and Brimhaven.
Go through the Spirit tree network by a planted Spirit Tree with 83 Farming Boostable on the Spirit Tree Patch north-east of the Brimhaven.

place.summary: The crater is now home to many monsters, consisting of ankou, skeletons, hellhounds, greater demons, and lesser demons. The undead roam around the northern area of the crater, while the demons roam the southern area - hellhounds in the middle, lesser demons to the south-west and greater demons to the south-east. The entire crater is a multi-way combat area for the purposes of player versus player combat.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The fastest way to access the crater is using the Wilderness Crater lodestone. 
• Take a canoe to the Wilderness pond then run south and use one of the northern entrances to the crater.
• Teleport to the level 35 obelisk using the obelisk network or a portable obelisk.

Regardless of the method of travel, players opted into PvP may be attacked by player killers while in the Wilderness.

Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.

Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.

Varrock has four main gates, all of which are open to the public. Each is guarded by several level 36 guards, although they are not aggressive. The north gate can be found near the Wilderness wall and is commonly used by those travelling to Wilderness Crater or exploring the Wilderness. The east gate can be found after following the northern path at the crossroads near northern Al Kharid. The west gate can be reached by travelling east from Gunnarsgrunn. The south gate can be reached by travelling north-west from Lumbridge. Near it is the Stone Circle, where many level 7 and 20 dark wizards can be found.

ml.name: Uncharted Isles
ml.text: The Gu ronin is an attackable NPC that can be found randomly on Uncharted Isles. They can be killed for combat experience. Like most human NPCs found on the Uncharted Isles, they are capable of using abilities in combat. While not aggressive, they are very accurate and hit very hard, and are clumped up in usually large groups, making it very dangerous to use area-of-effect attacks and abilities. They only use melee and are vulnerable to binds and stuns, making it possible to safely kill them from a distance if a binding spell such as Entangle is successfully cast on them.

place.title: Uncharted Isles
place.summary: The Uncharted Isles are a procedurally generated island exploration system that offers member players the ability to discover new, unmapped islands in The Arc region. The islands are high-level skilling destinations for Fishing, Woodcutting, Divination, Farming, Hunter and Mining. Each new island has effectively randomly generated hotspots and points of interest. There is no guarantee that any given island will have a specific resource present.

place.title: Catherby
place.summary: There is a range in Catherby to cook fish and some farmed produce. Catherby is also a convenient place to train Herblore after completing Druidic Ritual, as limpwurt roots and tarromin can be planted with a Farming level of 26 to make strength potions. There are also unicorns to the west, whose horns are used in making antipoison. Vials can be filled with water using one of the town's water sources. Useful objects can be caught with a big net bought from the fishing shop. With level 41 Fletching, oysters caught can be chiselled into pearl bolt tips, giving 6.25 Fletching experience per shell. Seaweed can also be caught, which is an ingredient for glass blowing.

get_inside.text: Kharidian Desert
Entrance
You can reach the camp by walking directly south from Shantay Pass.
Alternative routes to the camp include:
Teleporting to the Bandit Camp lodestone and then walking northeast.

Teleporting to Pollnivneach using a Slayer ring or Slayer cape (to Sumona), House Teleport (if the player's house is in Pollnivneach), a Pollnivneach tablet, or a Pollnivneach Teleport, and then walking west to the camp.
Using fairy ring code BIQ to teleport to the Kalphite Hive and then walking southeast.

When travelling the desert to the camp, players are advised to bring a water source, or special items such as the Tome of Frost, to avoid the effects of desert heat. Once inside the camp (including the underground mines), water is not needed.

place.title: Desert Mining Camp
place.summary: Inside the camp is a camel cart, a winch, the entrance to the underground mines, and a building that is the headquarters of Captain Siad. Siad's office has a chest and bookcases. Guards will throw players in the jail if they are wearing equipment (except weapon or ammo). If you are thrown in the cell and do not have the key, you can still escape by bending the bars on the window and climbing down rocks into the desert. All these items play a role in Tourist Trap.

get_inside.text: Asgarnia
The entrance to the courtyard.
Falador lodestone - Teleports near the north gate.
Falador Teleport - Teleports to the city square near the north gate. Requires level 37 Magic Magic and an air runes, a water rune, and a law rune. Falador teleport tablet may also be used.

Teleport to South Falador - Teleports to the south gate southern entrance. Unlocked at the Livid Farm, requires level 72 Magic Magic, being on the Lunar Spellbook and two astral runes, a law rune, and two air runes.
Skills necklace - Teleports to the Mining Guild's entrance.
Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) attuned to the giant mole - Teleports to the Falador Park.
Ring of respawn - Teleports to the White Knights' Castle after completion of Recruitment Drive.
Skills necklace or balloon transport system - Teleport to the Crafting Guild south-west of the city, and climb into the underwall tunnel shortcut (requires level 26 Agility Agility).

Falador can be entered through the north gate, which has a road leading to Barbarian Village, and features a variety of guards; from the underground Dwarven Mine (either from the Mining Guild or from a house in the north-eastern neighbourhood of the city); through the south gate near Port Sarim; or by Falador Teleport, a spell which requires level 37 Magic (also requiring a water rune, three air runes, and a law rune). The north and south gates are popular training spots for low level players hoping to level up on guards.

Those with level 5 Agility can also enter from the west by using the Agility shortcut on the crumbling wall on the west side of the city. Members also can enter by crawling under a hole in the southern wall or by using a grapple shortcut to climb over the northern wall.
Grappling

A hidey-hole can be built for the 2-way grapple shortcut over the northern wall located where the shortcut is indicated on the minimap. The hidey-hole is a buildable storage spot to store a crossbow and grapple and eliminates the need to carry a crossbow and grapple to use the shortcut. To construct the hidey-hole, level 29 construction is required, as well as a saw and hammer (the tool belt works), four planks, a bronze crossbow, mithril grapple, and four nails. It requires level 11 Agility, 19 Ranged, and 37 Strength to use.

Falador (IPAc-en | ' | f | æ | l | ə | d | ɔːr Respell-en | FAL-ə-dor ) is the capital of Asgarnia. It serves as the base of operations for the White Knights and Temple Knights, two Saradominist knightly organisations. It has a significant role in the mining and smithing industries, with the south-eastern section of the city being home to both the Mining Guild and the Artisans' Workshop, and a mining dungeon under the eastern half of the city. Falador's population is usually around 40,000, although it swelled to almost 80,000 during the Siege of Falador.

get_inside.text: Misthalin
Varrock east entrance
Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.

Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.

Varrock has four main gates, all of which are open to the public. Each is guarded by several level 36 guards, although they are not aggressive. The north gate can be found near the Wilderness wall and is commonly used by those travelling to Wilderness Crater or exploring the Wilderness. The east gate can be found after following the northern path at the crossroads near northern Al Kharid. The west gate can be reached by travelling east from Gunnarsgrunn. The south gate can be reached by travelling north-west from Lumbridge. Near it is the Stone Circle, where many level 7 and 20 dark wizards can be found.
Varrock east entrance.png | Varrock east entrance
Varrock south entrance.png | Varrock south entrance
Varrock north entrance.png | Varrock north gate

There are also several other less-official entrances. By travelling north from the road east of the Gunnarsgrunn, players can enter the Grand Exchange, and from there the Varrock Palace grounds. An Agility shortcut north-west of the Grand Exchange can be used by members with 21 agility, running two-way between Varrock and Edgeville.

get_inside.text: The humble gate to the city
pic: The humble gate to the city

get_inside.text: There are multiple ways of accessing Dorgesh-Kaan.

Players may enter the crack in the eastern wall of the cellar of Lumbridge Castle, through which Kazgar waits to lead players through the Dorgesh-Kaan mine. The entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan is just to the south-east of where Kazgar leaves the player. To follow Kazgar through the mines, the player is required to bring a light source.
The city can be accessed from the Kalphite Hive through the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon to the south of the city, although a light source is required.

There is a fairy ring in the dungeon to the south with the code AJQ. This may only be used if players have completed A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen up to the point where the fairy ring network is unlocked. A light source is needed in the dungeon. To exit from the dungeon to the city, go east of the ring, then go north, west and again to north until a ladder. Climb up the ladder to the Dorgesh-Kaan course, and climb down the stairs to the north to reach the southern part of the city.

The Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system may be used to travel to Dorgesh-Kaan from Keldagrim by rail (after Another Slice of H.A.M.), and vice versa. The tickets are free; a player need only wait less than a minute in the carriage for the departure. The train station in Keldagrim is located near the blast furnace in the south-east of the city, and the train station in Dorgesh-Kaan is on the floor 2 in the south-west corner of the city.
A player may use a Dorgesh-kaan sphere, obtained from Oldak by giving him molten glass and 2 law runes, for a one-click teleport to the city.

get_inside.text: Main entrance: In the foothills of the Ice Mountain, north of the Falador to Gunnarsgrunn road. Using a combat bracelet to teleport to the Edgeville Monastery is a quick way to get to this entrance.
Falador entrance: A building in the far northeast of Falador has stairs down to the south end of the mine. A Falador Teleport is a fast way to get here and to get to the next entrance.
South gate: Entrance to the Mining Guild, level 60 Mining required.

Mine cart: Members may use the Keldagrim minecart system to enter the mine in the north-west section. This two-way network allows players to travel between the Dwarven Mine and the bustling dwarven capital of Keldagrim. From the cart station in Keldagrim, it is also possible to travel to White Wolf Mountain and the Grand Exchange, provided that the quest Fishing Contest has been completed. One fast way to get to the mine is to take the carts from the Grand Exchange to Keldagrim and then to Ice Mountain. Also, the train station in Keldagrim is next to the carts and thus allows access from Dorgesh-Kaan, provided that the Another Slice of H.A.M. quest has been completed.
After completing the Perils of Ice Mountain quest, a trapdoor route becomes available within the Power Station next to Ice Mountain. It leads to Nurmof's room.

get_inside.text: Karamja
The Brimhaven bar
Brimhaven is located immediately north of the Karamja lodestone.

Brimhaven has a ship ride that will take the player to Ardougne for the low price of 30 coins. This ship is located in the northern part of Brimhaven. The price is lowered to 15 coins after completing the Easy Karamja achievements. Wearing a Ring of charos (a) will allow you to travel to and from Brimhaven for free.
The charter ships also dock in the Brimhaven Harbour. They provide rides to several other locations, for a fee.
If you have completed the Shilo Village quest, then Hajedy will take you for a ride in his cart to Shilo Village for the fee of 10-200 coins.

The House Teleport spell can be used if player-owned house is in Brimhaven. If the Love Story quest has been completed, players can use a Brimhaven tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to House tablet) to teleport to the Brimhaven house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.
The amulet of glory teleport to Musa Point, east of Brimhaven.

If the Holy Grail and A Fairy Tale Part II quests are completed, the Fisher Realm can be reached through the fairy ring system by using code BJR. Use the magic whistle, found at the northwest corner of the Fisher Realm, to exit the Fisher Realm and end up on the northwestern peninsula near the gold mine and Brimhaven.
Go through the Spirit tree network by a planted Spirit Tree with 83 Farming Boostable on the Spirit Tree Patch north-east of the Brimhaven.

Their name is derived from a dangerous creature native to the Gorajo realm.

ml.name: Barbarian Village
ml.text: Gunthor the Brave was a level 29 barbarian who lived in Barbarian Village. He was located in the Long Hall in the northern part of the village. He was stated to be a mighty warrior and a chieftain of the barbarians. On 21 September 2010, he was removed from the game and replaced with Chieftain Gunthor. Haakon the Champion replaced him as the new attackable boss of Barbarian Village.

get_inside.text: Misthalin
Gunnarsgrunn eastern entrance
The skull sceptre offers unlimited direct teleports to the centre of Barbarian Village
Teleport to Falador lodestone and head east
Teleport to Varrock lodestone go through the city and exit on the west side and continue west
Teleport to Edgeville lodestone and head south
Barbarian Village has two main entrances; east and west, and a few smaller ones. The western entrance has a road leading to Falador, while the eastern one leads to Varrock.

Barbarians are scattered throughout the whole town - the male ones are level 30, while the female ones are level 28. Outside of the village are unicorns. In The Long Hall, Chieftain Gunthor, the current leader of the settlement, and Haakon the Champion, the mightiest barbarian in the settlement, can also be found.

ml.name: Taverley
ml.text: A Guthixian druid is a possible foe in the God Statues Distraction and Diversion if any statue different than Juna is built at the Taverley statue spot. Even though he scales according to a player's combat level, he is quite easy to defeat if with a decent weapon. The fight is instanced. Food is not necessary if he is killed quickly.

get_inside.text: The Summoning Store
Walk south from Burthorpe.
If the Taverley lodestone has been activated, a player may teleport there via the Home Teleport spell.

Taverley may also be reached via the balloon transport system. This provides ready access to Taverley from Varrock (by the earth altar), Entrana (west side of the island), Crafting Guild, Castle Wars (to the east & north), or from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Reaching Taverley requires 1 set of logs after unlocking the route.

If a player's player-owned house is in Taverley they can teleport there with House Teleport. If the Love Story quest has been completed, players can use a Taverley tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to house tablet) to teleport to the Taverley house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.
To the north lies Burthorpe and Death Plateau.
To the south-east lies Falador - players can get there either by climbing over the crumbling wall (5 Agility required) or via the gate to the north-east of Taverley.

To the west lies White Wolf Mountain, which can be dangerous for new players to cross, and beyond lies Catherby - players who have completed the Fishing Contest quest can use the tunnel to the north-west of Taverley to go under rather than over White Wolf Mountain.

The village of Taverley lies to the north-west of Falador and is the westernmost province of the kingdom of Asgarnia. The town is often described as the druidic hub of Gielinor as most of its residents are druids, although the area has recently seen an influx of citizens from Burthorpe that had lost their homes to the troll invasion from the north. A small farm known as Astram Farm can be found to the north-west of the town, and a forest known as Ewean's Grove can be found to the north-east.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Walk south from Burthorpe.
• If the Taverley lodestone has been activated, a player may teleport there via the Home Teleport spell.
• Taverley may also be reached via the balloon transport system. This provides ready access to Taverley from Varrock (by the earth altar), Entrana (west side of the island), Crafting Guild, Castle Wars (to the east & north), or from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Reaching Taverley requires 1 set of logs after unlocking the route.
• If a player's player-owned house is in Taverley they can teleport there with House Teleport. If the Love Story quest has been completed, players can use a Taverley tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to house tablet) to teleport to the Taverley house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.

getting_there.heading: Nearby locations
getting_there.text:
• To the north lies Burthorpe and Death Plateau.
• To the south-east lies Falador - players can get there either by climbing over the crumbling wall (5 Agility required) or via the gate to the north-east of Taverley.
• To the west lies White Wolf Mountain, which can be dangerous for new players to cross, and beyond lies Catherby - players who have completed the Fishing Contest quest can use the tunnel to the north-west of Taverley to go under rather than over White Wolf Mountain.

God Statues is a Construction-based monthly Distraction and Diversion. The aim is to aid Copernicus Glyph in building up to five statues around Gielinor which act as prayer altars.
monthly reset countdown

• Completed or manually turned off tutorial mode
• Completed at least 60 Achievements
• Completed Let Them Eat Pie
